newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Haitai seeks probe into broadcast.
newsitem.headline: Haitai seeks probe into broadcast.

text.p: South Korea's Haitai Group said on Thursday it had asked the police to investigate the owner of a private broadcasting firm for spreading rumours the group had financial troubles.
A Haitai statement said the broadcasting firm, specialising in supplying information to stock investors, had reported Haitai affiliates had filed for a bailout due to liquidity shortages.

"(The report) caused plunges of share prices in Haitai Group companies from around May 21," the statement said. "The Haitai Group is in a good cash flow situation as the group's affiliates are enjoying a big demand season."
